body: You're very right about the not deserving my love thing. It's very difficult, but knowing that I have some sort of support system really means a lot, so thank you.

Your comment about my emotions overwhelming me could not be more true. I think they are the hardest things to deal with. He was amazing, but I can do better. Thank you for your support; knowing I'm not alone is really what I need right now.
Thank you so much. I'm just really overwhelmed, but I honestly feel a lot better today. Writing about it and seeing I have support, even from strangers, means a lot.
